credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of three men at twilight, dressed in denim jeans and cowboy hats, with their backs to the fire.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: A quiet evening at home (three men with their backs to the fire)
